result.instructions: Tools for Veyra, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much of my Veyra daily budget is left?"; "Pay 4.50 USDC on Base to this address for the dataset, and show me the transaction proof."; "List my last 10 Veyra payments and their status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Veyra data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run veyra_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run veyra_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run veyra_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. veyra_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: veyra_get_capabilities
tools.title: Get capabilities
tools.description: Return the networks, assets, limits and recipient allowlist this endpoint allows right now. Call it before paying to see what Veyra accepts.

tools.name: veyra_get_budget
tools.title: Get budget
tools.description: Return the remaining daily allowance, the amount spent today and the auto and ask bands. If a limit blocks a payment, ask the user; do not retry.

tools.name: veyra_list_payment_sources
tools.title: List payment sources
tools.description: List the masked payment sources this endpoint can use, and whether each can settle without a human. Returns no secrets.

tools.name: veyra_create_payment
tools.title: Create a payment
tools.description: Create a payment for an agent task, such as a paywalled API call or a dataset. Veyra applies the endpoint's limits before any money moves. Read the status: confirmed means USDC moved on-chain and tx_ref is the proof; confirmed_simulated means no real money moved; awaiting_approval means the user must open next_action.url. Do not retry while a payment is pending. If unsure whether a payment worked, call veyra_get_payment first. Reuse the same idempotency_key only to retry the same payment; a new key spends again.

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. 4.50.

reason.description: Why the agent makes this payment.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for this payment. Reuse it only to retry the same payment.

tools.name: veyra_get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Return the canonical state of one payment, including the rail that settled it, tx_ref and explorer_url once confirmed on a real rail. Call it before concluding that a payment failed.

payment_id.description: The payment id (from veyra_create_payment or veyra_list_payments).

tools.name: veyra_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List the recent payments of this endpoint.

tools.name: veyra_cancel_payment
tools.title: Cancel a payment
tools.description: Cancel a payment, but only while Veyra still allows cancelling it.

payment_id.description: The payment id (from veyra_create_payment or veyra_list_payments).
